notes.title: Weekly Nubby News #11 (9/5/2025)
notes.content:
[p]Hello nubblies, nubblings, and nubblers![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Whoa, it's been a while! Perhaps a little more than a week. Despite the misleading title, I'm gonna keep calling this blog "Weekly Nubby News" for old time's sake I guess.[/p][p][/p][p]In all seriousness, apologies for the wait on this one. When I take more time than usual to release a news post, it's usually not because I'm forgetting to write or feeling too lazy - typically it's due to a lack of things to write about. I hope this edition of WNN serves to quell the recent concerns that I've died or abandoned nubby. It has officially been 2 years since I started work on the game, and Nubby continues to pop the pegs of my heart :-)[/p][p]
Now, on to the news! [/p][p]
(But first, look at the canonized nubby biology, credits to @maionese on discord)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/c355ef80ed738e267bd249f657fba36e0d4a3b1c.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]V1.4 Progress:[/b][/p][p]==========[/p][p][/p][p]Progress on V1.4 persists! I faced a number of major hiccups that slowed production in mid-August, but I've hit some big milestones recently, so that's been encouraging!

Among other aspects of V1.4, I'm coming close to finishing up work on the final nubby challenge. Well - technically the final 5 challenges. I'll talk about that now!
[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Nubby Trials:[/b][/p][p][b]==========[/b] 

The ultimate test of your nubbing abilities has an official name: "The Nubby Trials".

A long time ago I mentioned that I wanted to add a sort of "end-game" challenge to nubby that would give those who complete the challenges in the current version of nubby some extra stuff to work on. After a lot of prototyping, I finally landed on the nubby trials.

Basically, the nubby trials are a set of 5 challenges, with each challenge containing 5 mini-challenges for you to complete in a single run. 

The nubby trials are going to be a lot easier to grasp once you see them in-game, so I'll show you!

(Image of nubby trials menu gui below, [b]specifics of the level shown are subject to change by release[/b])

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/444c853d83da933e7057a396711d0242b184ceff.png"][/img][/p][p]You'll notice in the screenshot that the letters N,U,B,B, and Y are important in the nubby trials. Your goal in each level of the nubby trials is to spell the word "NUBBY". If you obtain all the letters, you win and unlock the next level of the nubby trials! There are 5 levels that increase in difficulty.

When you've selected a nubby trials level to play on, you start the run without any letters. One by one, you obtain letters by completing tasks by their required rounds (the tasks are referred to as trials). This is why I referred to each level of the nubby trials as a collection of 5 mini challenges. 

The image above shows all the tasks required to obtain each letter for level 1 of the nubby trials. The 5 trials you must complete to win vary from level to level. You're currently seeing the tasks for level 1.[/p][p][/p][p]Some trials depend on you limiting yourself in some way over the course of many rounds. In the picture above, examples of this are the first trial (red letter "N") and the second trial (orange letter "U"). In the case of the red letter "N", you will obtain this letter after beating round 33, under the condition that you have only used 1 or less items at a time from rounds 1 through 33. Once you've obtained the letter "N", you're free to use as many items as you want. However, now you have to worry about the task for completing the letter "U".[/p][p]
Other trials are impossible to fail, and serve more as an obstacle for you to overcome, rather than a trial. An example of this is the third trial (the yellow letter "B"). You'll automatically obtain this letter at round 53, at the cost of all of your money.

Another type of trial is shown in the fourth trial (the green letter "B"). This kind of trial requires you to do complete a task once, as long as you do it by the required round. Although, like I previously mentioned, letters are obtained one by one; meaning that trial 4 can only be attempted once you've obtained the yellow letter "B" on round 53. 

Because each level of the nubby trials can only be beaten if you spell the whole word, "NUBBY", failure to complete any of the 5 trials in a level will result in an immediate game over. Each level of the nubby trials requires you to come up with a strategy to beat it. You won't be able to use the same strategy twice from one level to another. 

Here's an image of what the nubby trials gui looks like in a run :)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/d42697c92ad3ab0dccb8556ebdfa37ec30336bf1.png"][/img]If you're dedicated enough to attempt the nubby trials, your victories will be rewarded with nubby cosmetic skins that can only be unlocked by beating the nubby trials! A new nubby cosmetic will be rewarded for beating [i]each[/i] level of the nubby trials. See the previous edition of weekly nubby news for sneak peaks at what some of those cosmetics look like :]

Note: Not all nubby cosmetics are unlocked via beating nubby trials, most of them are unlocked with stars. You'll finally be able to spend all those stars you've been hoarding!


[b]The Final Supervisor - "Dwarf Tony":
==========


[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/40db02b87f88015a9bfdc700e9bad586916dc358.gif"][/img]

I haven't talked a lot about what I'm going to do with the final supervisor named "Dwarf Tony". This was a community-made supervisor, created back when I ran a contest on the community discord server. I chose this fan made entry out of the hundreds that I received during the contest because something about it spoke to me spiritually.. and it still does..  [/p][p][/p][p]Over the past 3-4 months I've been thinking a lot about what I'm going to do with dwarf tony and i think I've finally landed on it. My plan as of now is to lean into the idea of gems.. or stones? Because he's a dwarf and dwarves mine stuff? (idk I'm not a dwarf-head)   [/p][p][/p][p]I thought it would be cool to add around 5 new stone/gem themed pegs that appear on the board and have their own special effects to help you out in your dwarf tony runs. Maybe even adding in a few negative effect stone/gem themed pegs to balance out the good with the evil. I have a list of brainstormed ideas for special gem/stone themed pegs (for both helpful and hurtful ones). Still in the middle of developing this supervisor's gimmick, but this should give you a general idea of the direction I'm heading with this.   [/p][p][/p][p]As always, I'm listening to community ideas so if you've got a really cool idea that came to mind when I mentioned stone/gem themed peg go ahead and comment here or on the discord about your idea! 
[/p][p]
 [b]In Conclusion:  ==========    [/b]Thanks for keeping up with the nubby news! Everything is still going swell on my end. Nubby mobile is progressing at a constant rate, just like progress on V1.4 is. As of now, I cannot tell if V1.4 will release before nubby mobile, or vice versa. Maybe they'll release at the same time and it will be nubby's second coming. Who knows!  [/p][p]I appreciate you reading to the end, and I hope you enjoyed seeing some of the progress. More news posts are still yet to come!  [/p][p]Until next time, ~Mog     [/p]

notes.title: Weekly Nubby News #10 (8/2/2025)

Weekly Nubby News #10 is here! Can't believe I've already done 10 of these.

I have significantly more work done on the nubby skins than the cursor cosmetics, so I'll share some of those with you today! [b]This list is not fully comprehensive and there are quite a few more that I'm not showing right now.[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/7ea5ae8700f47a386099a5e7d14a213b638ee2a0.gif"][/img]

Next, the critically endangered aquatic species, [i]Nubbicus Aquaticus,[/i] was captured and brought to the factory for classified reasons. Meet "Blubby" by ianokay


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/6117e05679877f61edcb45aa7a27de109d24a6b4.gif"][/img]

Getting darker - feast your eyes on this lovely monstrosity by sirpodzol (who also created the steam page art for nubby). Meet "Teratoma Nubby"!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/fe3a78cb84ef883e522eb6c98326c533884e8f63.gif"][/img]
In conclusion:
==========

As always, thank you for reading! I'm very happy that the nubby community continues to see growth and that people are still keeping up with progress. Thank you very much for supporting my work and keeping up with the nubby news!

We're continuing to come closer to the finish line for nubby mobile and I'm getting really excited for that. No specific release date as of now, but our first round of closed playtesting was recently concluded - so we're getting there.

V1.4 still has a lot of work left to be done on it and I admit that I (once again) underestimated how much time this would take. With my priorities split 50/50 on the mobile version of nubby and V1.4, it will be some time yet before we see our nubby skins and all the other stuff in game for V1.4, so thank you for your patience!

Until next time,
~Mog
[/p]

notes.title: Weekly Nubby News #9 (7/16/25)
notes.content:
[p]Greetings nubblygubbywubblybubblygrubblys,


Welcome to Weekly Nubby News #9! In this edition, I'm going to be talking about what I've been working on for V1.4 and sharing the results from the nubby science poll.


[b]Progress on V1.4:
==========

[/b]Lately I've been working away at V1.4, the next big content update for nubby. I thought I'd share something cool I'm currently finishing up!


Meet "Jelly", the most involved food item I've ever added to nubby.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/884ac3ed0edbdb079f8b3d5ff4f5a30bef5a8cd6.gif"][/img]
Jelly is a very special little guy. As of now, the effect for jelly is "Eat -> Upgrades cafe food items that are currently available for purchase".

Yes, you heard that right! This means that every food item in cafe nubby now has an upgraded counterpart, including the new jelly item. Upgraded foods work slightly different than upgraded items. Items from nubby mart / black market are designed to be equally as powerful (or slightly more powerful) than having 2 copies of an item. Upgraded foods are a bit more variable than upgraded items in this regard. Because the effects of food items don't always work with the "2x as powerful" logic, I had to get creative with some upgraded foods.

For example, the moldy sandwich food item that you can find while playing on balogna tony randomizes the triggers of all items in your inventory. For the upgraded counterpart of moldy sandwich, the tentative effect is: "Eat -> Randomizes the triggers of items in slots 2-7. The item in slot 1 is not affected". In this case, the advantage of eating an upgraded moldy sandwich is that you could keep an item that has a really good trigger in slot 1 to not risk its trigger being randomized to something less ideal. I won't share every upgraded food effect here, but basically you'll find a lot of variability in upgraded food items, further than just "twice as good as the non-upgraded version".

Ok, now on to the nubby science!

[b]Nubby Science Poll Results:
==========[/b]

A couple weeks ago I shared a poll with you all that asked questions about your preferences / dislikes in nubby (e.g. favorite board layout, favorite item, least favorite item, etc.). Over 6,500 people submitted responses to the poll, which is spectacular. Thank you!

I said I'd share the results in the next nubby news, so here you go!

(Huge shoutout to nubby community members: Arny, rccat, and SovietRedOnion for putting time and effort into gathering and presenting the data!)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/05c5c03468050c7167029cfe3d88a112a1b891e4.png"][/img]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/e4496a4581f85ec42b92bbb91731bfcba7ac5fb7.png"][/img]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/8a32a9e7d112fe041af4a854fb76fd4855192c99.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/689658634e3bcbaf1a0eb8de7c0e4c6111621f97.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/e76156e2af8b0c0fd4d7d38a9bd0d3ef0350e9ef.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/0a2cd4b12b2288d876ae584387eb38b2d27fdf8f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/ec4aaca59dde57814101ab590afa2b29070ae9f5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/834b5289fe61fb344a3565e508806216c5101ce7.png"][/img]

[b]Wrap up + thank you:[/b]
==========

As always, thanks for reading and thank you for supporting me and my work! I hope you find amusement in the poll results. For the most part, I wasn't too surprised about the top favorites and least favorites for things, but its still very interesting to see how the community is divided in personal preferences.

Also, to anyone who has pre-ordered the nubby plush, I sincerely thank you for your support! I'm super excited for everyone to receive their nubby in the mail!

That's all from me for now. I'll keep dropping V1.4 devlogs in future editions of WNN as I make progress, so stay tuned, nubbywubblies.

~Mog
[/p]

notes.title: V1.34 Patch Notes (7/11/2025)
notes.content:
Surprise update today! This is just a big ol' bunch of bug fixes with the only real addition being a new common perk that I think you will like! 

Apologies for going off schedule. I previously said that the next update you'd see would be V1.4 sometime in late summer. After the release of V1.33 (autosave update), there were some really annoying bugs that I wanted to fix before a rather long period of no updates. This build is a lot more stable than V1.33, I hope you'll enjoy the fixes I made here. As always, you can find the full list of changes below.

Bug fixes:
==========
-Fixed the bug where setting up a chain of multiple squids to transform into a "first peg popped" item would result in most of the squids in the chain having their effect skipped. (AKA the "lazy squids bug")
-Added a failsafe for save data corruption. If you've experienced a crash where the game crashes immediately once it launches, that's due to a save file being corrupted and the game trying to read the save data but failing. This isn't a solution to save corruption, but it does fix the immediate crash, thus preventing the game from becoming unplayable.
-Fixed round 900 crash in endless mode
-Fixed issue with crashing in endless after receiving a perk
-Fixed issue in endless where you could come across final bosses again.
-Warlock perk description updated
-You can no longer use the load button to access endless mode in challenges
-Pause button in upper right corner of screen now appears in endless mode
-End game button now appears when loading into an endless mode save
-Alien now appears in nubby mart (like all the other black market items) while playing as criminal tony
-Non-upgraded inflatable dolphin beach ball summon is now counted as a summon.
-House'O'Cards perk now triggers "20 pegs popped" items.
-House'O'Cards perk now triggers "12 pegs popped" items.
-House'O'Cards perk now triggers items with "x pegs popped" triggers as their second trigger while playing on mutant tony.
-Crazy straw can now be obtained while playing as C.E.O. Tony
-Dave and Lentil food effect outcomes are now affected by game seed.
-Fixed bug where if you spammed the "exit" button on the claw machine you could break it and cause the claw machine to stay on screen for the next round.
-Fixed bug where insulation would give points even if it didn't hit a peg.
-Fixed the crash caused by eating the chip item in the cafe and then grabbing another food item while the chip was being consumed. 
-Fixed odds issue with flaming skull item: odds changed from 1/11 to 1/10, as was originally intended.
-Fixed the unnecessary extra gap in the item description of squid while playing as mutant tony.
-Fixed bug where 1Q+ pegs were valued at 0.
-Broken socket can now be triggered by other broken sockets.
-Broken Socket now triggers twice on glass tony


Additions:
==========
-Added common perk: "Archaic Perk" - Every 1.5 seconds -> Force-triggers all non-upgraded items.
	-This perk does not appear in the "Times Up!" challenge.


Other changes:
==========
-Starting with this update, existing autosaves will be deleted when you update the game due to incompatibility in saved data.

notes.title: Nubby Patch V1.32 (The Autosave Patch)
notes.content:
Hello! Welcome to the long awaited V1.32! I'm happy to get this out to the public so I can begin work on some really fun stuff. Either way, enjoy autosaving! 

V1.3.2 Patch Notes:
==========


Bug fixes:
==========
-Fixed bug where egg missiles from rubber chicken didn't collide with pegs on hunter tony

-Kebab perk and croissant perk now have their triggers randomized in bologna tony

-Fixed the peg revival glitch with cactus and uranium rod (shoutout to Seymour for the help)

-Game no longer crashes are round 467 (thanks again, Seymour)

-Fixed the bug where if you spammed the launch nubby button right at the start of the game, you'd get a 9999x restock.

-Fixed bug where you could steal corrupted items as criminal tony and end up with negative money as a result

-Asbestos insulation summons now count as summons





Additions:
=========
-Implemented autosave system (yippee)




Other Changes:
==========

-For lunar perk: the amount of force triggers is now determined by the round number instead of how many rounds it has been in your inventory

-Warlock perk now triggers all "Nubby Dies ->" items.

-Asbestos insulation now gives 5%-10% of the round goal. Upgraded asbestos gives between 12%-17% of the round goal (sad, but we all knew this was coming)

-Broken socket now triggers on: "item to the right of me triggers"; Has a 25% chance to execute its cluster shock effect.
	-Same thing for upgraded broken socket.

-Coin sound effect is less shrill

-In the in-game pause menu, "Abandon Game" button is replaced by "Save and Quit" button.

-For "Pol's Bane" challenge: T-Block, E-Block, and Flibby Flobbies are no longer obtainable.

-For "Time's Up!" challenge: Cheesy Perk is no longer obtainable.

-All-seeing pyramid item no longer appears in the early game and has the same item weight as T-Block.

-Avocado price changed from 11 to 9.
-Evil goose priced changed from 6 to 5.
-Flamethrower price changed from 9 to 7.

I appreciate you!
~Mog
[/p]

notes.title: Weekly Nubby News #7 (News about V1.4)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/a758e6404fc6e2f36cff62e277d866f229c4db2a.png[/img]

Greetings Nublings,



Welcome to Weekly Nubby News #7 and happy pride month!

In this edition of WNN, I'm going to be briefly discussing my current progress and works in progress, and then setting some expectations for the next major update to nubby... V1.4!!!


Update on V1.3.2 (upcoming patch):
==========

In the development of nubby, V1.3.2 is my current focus. This is the last big patch before V1.4 and it will introduce an autosave / load system. This has proven to be a bit of an obstacle because it involves reworking a lot of code to make this system fit. However, I'm looking forward to finishing this addition because it's a big quality of life improvement. It's a bit difficult to give an exact time estimate on when this will be finished, but I'm hoping to have this patch released around June 12th. That is tentative and subject to change because technical difficulties are likely.

Regardless, it will be nice to be able to start up a game of nubby, save your game, then load back into it the next day when you're bored. Cheers to progress!




Update on nubby mobile:
==========

For those curious about the progress of the mobile port for NNF - things are still trucking along and progress is being made. It isn't near completion yet, but I'm feeling confident about our work pacing and I'm very excited to share this with you all. One day you can bring nubby along with you in your pocket! Pocket nubby!




Discussing V1.4:
==========

Now for the exciting news on V1.4!

I've talked a bit about V1.4 in previous editions of WNN, but I was leaving things vague and my time estimates were quite off. This is going to be a [b]big update[/b] and add a lot of things. Before I talk about a release date for V1.4, I want to discuss what you can look forward to! 

In V1.4 you can expect:
---
-A cosmetics menu with unlockable nubby skins and peg skins, most cosmetic nubby skins were made by the community way back in the demo days! This menu will be accessible through the title screen. The cosmetics menu will be managed by a very fashionable new character, "Lady La Mode"! (See gif below)

-A "warehouse" menu that is akin to a "bestiary" or encyclopedia of sorts. Sup nubheads. Welcome to [b]Weekly Nubby News #5![/b]


It's been a while! As I established in WNN #4, I've been on a bit of a burnout break. Thus, there hasn't been too much to share because progress was slow in that period. But, now that I'm revitalized and fresh as a cucumber, we're back!

In this edition of WNN I'm going to be talking about the specifics of patch V1.3.1 and then sharing out some exciting news...



[b]Patch V1.3.1:[/b]
=========

For the most part, my plans for upcoming updates have not changed in terms of content. As for release dates, those are being pushed back a bit because I was on burnout-break for a while longer than I initially thought I would.

Patch V1.3.1 is going to have a number of quality of life changes as the main addition. See the picture below to view nubby's new (and toggleable) assist mode.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/2eb48919463091eac5cd4637ce765602ab5d4013.png[/img]


But what is assist mode, you might ask? Well, assist mode is a toggleable extension of the normal gui. Heres what it does:

1. It records and displays stats from the current/previous turn.
2. For items, you can view how many times each one has triggered in the current/previous turn.
3. You may have noticed a crosshair-target-thingy over the juicy 128 peg in the picture. This is not an auto-aim feature. This is simply an indicator of the highest peg on the board. It highlights all of the highest pegs on the board, so if you had two 128 pegs, they would both get a crosshair-target-thingy.

Basically, it's a package of small things to assist you - hence the name. I might add more features to it in the future, but that's what it's going to be for now.

Aside from assist mode, patch V1.3.1 makes some miscellaneous changes and additions. I'll list a few here:

[i] (note that specifics here are subject to change, have not play tested this patch yet)[/i]

-2 new items. One is the very special food pictured below, the other is a surprise.
-Glass tony reworked to fit the "glass cannon" archetype. You are limited to 2 lives, and every time an item triggers, it triggers twice. Glass cannon tony!
-Multiples of perks stack on top of each other in the gui, for organizational purposes.
-Adjusted nubby physics to fit between V1.2's physics and V1.3's physics. I don't think I'm going to change it again.
-Fixed various major bugs.
-A couple buffs and changes to some items and perks: Alien, trophy perk, croissant perk, and fishman.
-Added voice overs for supervisors...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/7f82b71a6b24267ddf1bf8ab12c05fbd7776ce36.gif[/img]

As for a release date, I'm planning for [b]May 16[/b]. Now, on to some exciting news...


[b]Exciting News #1[/b]
=========

I'm excited to announce that Nubby's Number Factory is officially getting a mobile port! Nubby is going to be coming to apple and google devices.

I'm not going to be talking about specific dates for the release now, because it's a bit too early for that. Though, we have officially started the porting process. It's happening! You'll be able to bring nubby with you, wherever you go. Even at work!

Over the coming months, you will be getting more updates on the progress of the mobile version, and details about the release date and pricing.

Also, I want to put this next piece of information out there before any rumors start: [b]The mobile version will not have ads. The mobile version will not have microtransactions.[/b] Our plans for right now is to have the game sold as a free version from the appstore/playstore. The free version will have about as much content as the current demo on steam (Though, I'm looking to give it a makeover to make it look more like the full version, just with less content). You can choose to play the free version, or you can pay once to purchase the full version that has full content. That's the only form of monetization I'm going to allow in my game.

I also want to announce that I am not porting this by myself. I'm working alongside the very respectable company, PolyCrunch Games to make nubby mobile the highest quality product we can produce. I'm very excited to get this out in the world!


[b]Exciting News #2[/b]
=========

I'm going to PAX East in Boston! I'll be there May 9 and May 10th. I'm going there as a video game enthusiast, not a demo exhibitor or anything. 

Just wanted to throw that out there, in case any nubby enthusiasts are going. If you see irl Tony walking around the expo hall, come up and say hi! I might be cosplaying Tony...

=========


That's it for this week's edition of WNN. I'll hopefully be sticking to the weekly schedule for a while, but if I don't post just know that the reason is because nothing note-worthy is happening. I'm still alive!

As always, thank you for reading, and thank you for playing! Peace out to the coolest gaming community I've ever been a part of.

~Mog

notes.title: Weekly Nubby News #3 (4/2/25)
notes.content:
Greetings Nubheads.



Welcome to Weekly Nubby News #3! 

In this edition, I'm looking mostly to inform nubby enthusiasts of where Nubby's at in terms of updates and talk about the next big update (V1.4).


So, V1.3 came out last Sunday and so far, things have been going pretty well. For the most part, people seem to be happy with the changes made. Obviously nerfing items isn't something I like doing, but in order for the game to meet my final vision, adjustments must be made. To be frank, the game is in a bit of awkward stage right now. I have some top secret documents that describe "phases" that I'm putting Nubby through. These phases are all working towards my final vision for Nubby, where I could finally be satisfied with the game.

Right now, Nubby is sort of in between phases. While some people are happy with NNF in it's current state, I'm striving for something more. All you need to know is that Nubby hasn't taken its final form yet. We're gonna get there one day.

With that out of the way, I want to talk about the near future of Nubby, address some criticisms I've been receiving, then finally finish off with what's to come for the next big update.


Near future of nubby (patches):
===

I have a patch planned for Nubby to fix up some bugs/crashes, and rebalance some things. I assume this will most likely be out some time next week. It's not going to be a big content update, just some tweaks.


Criticisms of V1.3:
===

The biggest criticism I've been receiving from V1.3 is that the Nubby physics feel bad. This one actually surprised me a lot. To understand why this surprised me, I'll explain the context of Nubby physics, and why I changed it. 

So basically, one of the biggest complaints pre-V1.2 was that Nubby's physics felt too random. I found myself agreeing. Nubby's physics do actually have a small amount of RNG involved. Pre-V1.3, every time nubby bounces, his degree of reflection was offset by (-2 degrees, -1 degrees, 0 degrees, 1 degree, or 2 degrees). I thought, well in that case if its too random, I'll just reduce the maximum offset.

The reason why the large blowback from this surprised me, is that the physics were only changed by 1 degree! In V1.3, Nubby's physics are offset by (-1 degree, 0 degree, or 1 degree). That was the ONLY change made to the physics and I'm astounded that so many players noticed a degree change of just 1! Maybe I just don't play my game enough to notice, but I just cannot, for the life of me, notice a difference. 

Usually, I'd listen to my heart and do what I think is right, but considering I can't notice a difference, and the player base is split 50/50 on this, I'm going to provide a compromise. I'm not going to explain exactly how I will compromise, mostly because I haven't figured out a compromise yet. I will eventually stumble upon a solution that pays respect to both opinions. That will be for the next patch. You are heard in the nubby community.




The future / Looking ahead at V1.4
===

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/b3437ecc671fc2319bcd86ab92003e5d82d3c655.gif[/img]


There's still plenty of work to be done with Nubby! I've got big plans for the next update.

In V1.4, I'm choosing to emphasize QOL systems and progression.

I will divide these two topics and talk about each one separately to give you a vague idea of what to expect in the next update.

V1.4 Quality of Life:
===
-Implementing a stat tracker that would allow the true nubheads to closely monitor data such as: Item activations per round, pops/halves/doubles per round, and total activations/pops/doubles/etc. throughout the whole game. If there is a chunk of data that YOU would like to see visually displayed on the stat tracker, leave it in the comments below! (this was originally a feature meant to come out in V1.3, but I didn't think it was comprehensive enough, so I didn't add it in yet)

-Perk stacking (clumps similar perks together so you can actually see what perks you have in the late game instead of seeing a mess)

-Various GUI / UX / visibility improvements

-More explanatory item effects. People often get confused between peg popping and peg halving, and I'd like to explain concepts like these more thoroughly in the game. This is just an example of one of the places that I want to be more descriptive.

-POSSIBLY: The warehouse! This is going to be accessible from the title screen and is adjacent to a "bestiary" or "collections" tab in other games. This is a MAYBE for this update. I'd like to have it done soon because it works with game progression.


V1.4 Progression:
===

-The biggest change to progression that I want to make is implementing a game mode called "Promotion mode or Overtime mode" where you will ascend to higher levels upon beating the game, and each level has increased difficulty, maxing out at ~20-30 levels, where you'd beat the final challenge. Ideally, after each level there would be some sort of item/perk unlock. I want to add this mode because I feel like after beating the challenges, there's not much left to do.

-As for steam achievements, I think this is the update that will bring those into the game. They will most likely be scattered throughout the game, rather than focusing on one specific aspect of the game. For example, I will NOT be centering all the achievements on beating challenges. 

Additional notes for V1.4
===

As for new items/perks, there might be a few, or there might be a lot. I'm more focused on adding new ways to interact with the systems already at play, rather than bloating up the item pool. Though, I think we still have a long way to go before I would consider the item pool "bloated". V1.3 was an improvement on build variety, but I still think we can do more. It will not be the focal point of V1.4, but you will definitely see more items coming in future updates.

===


Also, the soundtrack for Nubby is out on bandcamp! Go check it out and support Vinegart. All moneys go directly to him!


That's all for Weekly Nubby News! Thanks for reading and thanks for playing!


-Mog

	-Stars are a currency. They are obtained by doing well in-game.
	-In a game, 1 star is granted per boss round defeated in that game. For example, a game over on round 65 would grant 3 stars.
		-The exception: winning a non-challenge game grants 5 stars, and beating any challenge grants 10 stars.
	-If you already have supervisors unlocked from beating challenges, they will still be unlocked for you.

		-Rare item mystery box: Contains a random rare item.

notes.title: Weekly Nubby News #1 (3/16/25)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/96adf89a43ee9f103450ea8df9a54d4b73474984.png[/img]


Greetings Nublings! Welcome to the very first edition of Weekly Nubby News!

My, my, it has been a week. 

I'd like to start by introducing myself for those I haven't had the pleasure to meet yet. My name is Ethan, and I go by the alias, MogDog. I am the solo developer of Nubby's Number Factory and I run the game development studio, "MogDogBlog Productions".

The point of Weekly Nubby News is to keep you informed on what's going on in the development of Nubby. I plan on doing these weekly / bi-weekly and I'm not stopping anytime in the foreseeable future. I think it's important to stay transparent with where I'm at on progress with the game.

In these letters, I will be addressing player concerns and setting expectations for what's to come to Nubby. If you'd like to discuss ANY of the topics I go over in this letter, I am active in the community and I will try to participate. I'm very open to criticism and my opinions and beliefs can be swayed from a well-made argument.

I'll start with some FAQs from players in a Q&A format.


FAQS:
====

Q: Are you gonna add more content?
A: Yes! Absolutely! Nubby's still got plenty of room for improvement, and I love working on it. I can't see myself being done with it anytime soon. You'll all be receiving plenty of free content updates to the game in the coming months.

Q: Will there ever be a DLC?
A: Most likely. There are a lot of concepts that I've been kicking around that are a little too deep to fit into the base game. I think these ideas would be perfect for people who love Nubby and are ready to take a step into deeper strategy, math, and progression.

Q: Is there going to be achievements?
A: Yes. However, I am going to take my time on them and think them through like a decent game developer, instead of rushing them and throwing out a pile of crap for players to stumble over. To be completely transparent, that's what happened with the challenges. I cannot give a specific date for the achievements, but they are coming.

Q: Will there be mobile port?
A: That depends on how well I'm doing financially a couple months from now. At the pace we're going, I would absolutely capitalize on the mobile market because I think Nubby is a perfect game for that format (no microtransactions, I swear).

Q: Will there be a console/switch port?
A: I have not made any plans to do so and the game isn't popular enough to get a port for those. Yet. 
(I would do it if I got the chance)

Q: Will there be localization?
A: Yes! There will! I have people who I know will be localizing the game for Russian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and French. If you would like to help out with localization, I am 100% willing to take you in. Reach out to me (@andersonethan1020@gmail.com) if you would like to help!

Q: When will there be localization?
A: Once the game is stable, and balanced (or at least sort of balanced), I am going to start allowing translations. I believe this will come in 1-2 months. Apologies for the wait time.

Player Concerns:
====

-A lot of players do not like the challenges, and REALLY don't like that supervisors are barred behind challenges. I'm going to amend that in the coming update. More info on the challenges/supervisor unlock system rework below.

-There are remarks that the scaling in Nubby is fundamentally flawed, and restocks technically don't matter. I want to clarify some things, and talk about how I plan to fix the problem. I'll try my best to explain my rationale here - basically, I need the round goal to be consistently difficult throughout the game to make it exciting. The problem that people have is that they'll restock 5000x times, and be no better off than restocking 1x time in the next round. As many of you have noticed, this is because the round goal scales to how well you're doing. The round goal is calculated by adding the sum total of all pegs and their factors together, and multiplying the total by an ever-increasing number, which is consistent throughout runs. If the score scaled in a linear fashion and you just so happened to restock 9999x times at round 42 for example, the rest of the game would be stupidly easy. Because scores vary so much in Nubby throughout runs, it needs to be this way. 

-Now that I've explained the rationale - the issue of "then why should I even care if I get 9999x restocks?" still persists and is completely valid. I want to amend this by implementing permanent stat/variable upgrades (that would cost a lot of coins) , and add more permanent buffs from food items in the shop. This is going to be an experiment. (again, feel free to discuss this in the comments, if you have another idea for a possible solution to the "coins are worthless" problem)

-Moving on, there have been concerns about there being too much RNG involved in various aspects of the game. I would like to say that the comments about this have heavily swayed my opinions towards my usage of RNG, and I want to rework some of those aspects to be more decision based, rather than luck based


The Future of Nubby:
====

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/d6f86562017794a43af392f26c4fc103f75faafb.gif[/img]

-Now on to the fun part, a big ol' content update (Version 1.3) is coming down the pipeline! 

-I'm going to be adding (THIS IS TENTATIVE) ~12 new items, ~12 new foods, and ~10 new perks. This isn't going to be the last of this sort of update either. I have a lot of ideas for items, and I really want build variety and clear build paths to shine brighter than it currently is.

-In V1.3, I'm going to try my hand at delivering challenges that are actually decent. As of now, a couple of them are fun and actually make the player change their strategy to overcome a challenge, rather than arbitrarily disabling x feature and causing frustration. Not all challenges will be reworked, but most will have a change made to them.

-This update will change the way supervisors are unlocked. There will be an experience system, where you gain experience from doing well on runs, and supervisors will be unlocked based on your experience level. To me, this seems like a fair system that rewards good runs with new content. Once again, your feedback is appreciated.

-On a side note, the wonderful musician, Vinegart, is putting together some zone-specific variants of the theme songs to give the zones a more distinct personality. When this update is rolled out, the soundtrack will be available for purchase on the steam page. If you like the soundtrack, pick it up! All proceeds from the soundtrack are going directly to Vinegart, so support him. The man is an artist.

-Finally, there will be a plethora of bug/crash fixes for this update (the current version is admittedly a little rough around the edges. My bad...)

***You can expect this update to arrive before March 30.


Final Notes:
====

To end on a high note, this week changed my life. I cannot believe that we're sitting here with such positive ratings in the first 10 days of release.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for the support. I truly love making games, and now I can focus on my passion full time.


Long live Nubby!
-Mog
